semiconductor_relevance: High — Tanaka Precious Metals provides critical materials and compounds used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Tanaka Precious Metals Shanghai Co., Ltd. specializes in the production and supply of precious metal materials and compounds for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include low-temperature sintering pastes, precious metal powders, and various electroplating solutions, which are essential for semiconductor manufacturing and electronic components.
capabilities: Low-temperature sintering pastes for gold-gold bonding (AuRoFUSE™)
Cyanide-free gold plating and electroplating solutions

regional_presence.China: Tanaka Precious Metals Shanghai Co., Ltd. operates in China, focusing on the supply of precious metal materials for the semiconductor industry.
